text.name: Iran: SWIFT Cutoff and the Deal
text.rules: Record "disconnected". LIO spends 2 points. LIO chooses: Trade relief for limits? If yes, record "deal signed", then LIO spends 2 points, then SAE spends 1 point; if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: SWIFT disconnected sanctioned Iranian banks on 17 March 2012; the nuclear agreement with Iran was concluded on 14 July 2015, and the United States withdrew from it on 8 May 2018.
